banned_phrases.note: D022b/red-team A4. Normalisation before matching: hyphens, line breaks and runs of white space become one space; case-insensitive. Stems are banned anywhere; form words are banned in a sentence that also names a law or equation (subject words) unless that very word is negated (a negation word within 3 tokens before it, in the same clause; red-team N2, N3); approved text of PREREG 11 / 11a must not match (tested). The gate auditor still reads the manuscript.
